title.en: Multi-Layer AI-Tic Feature Library & Cross-Check Rubric
title.zh: 五层 AI 口癖特征库与多信号交叉核对准则

synthesizedFrom.focus: Inflated significance, -ing commentary tails, copula inflation, negative parallelisms, rule of three
24 concrete AI writing tells, author voice loading, soul/personality preservation
Chinese translationese, abstract noun stacking, stiff structural signposting
Banned structural transitions, formulaic openers/closers, anti-drama restraint
20+ punchy writing filters against robotic symmetry and corporate fluff
Removing pre-emptive hedging and defensive boundary disclaimers
Empirical cross-model frequency baselines for Chinese AI cliché phrases
Register separation and blocking cheesy forced-casual fake-human fillers
36 Chinese AI habits paired with anti-overcorrection guards
Multi-axis weighting (excess lexicon + contrast frames + frequent trigrams)
Categorized pattern matching paired with structural density checks

name.en: Lexical Buzzwords, Calques & Forced Synonym Cycling
name.zh: 词汇层：AI 集中黑话、翻译腔与强行同义词轮换

en: Over-represented AI vocabulary clusters: delve, tapestry, pivotal, holistic, seamless, underscore, testament to, realm of, ever-evolving, navigate complexities
Empty abstract buzzwords replacing concrete nouns/verbs (empower, leverage, robust ecosystem, transformative paradigm)
Forced synonym cycling ('the engine -> the platform -> the architecture -> the backbone' for one concrete component)
zh: 空洞 AI 集中黑话集群：赋能、抓手、闭环/全闭环、生态矩阵、深度协同、降本增效、维度、心智、颗粒度、组合拳
高密度中文翻译腔与公文抽象名词堆叠：在……的背景下、不可否认的是、毫不夸张地说、扮演着……角色、提供有力支撑、进行优化/开展推进
强行同义词轮换（同一具体系统在同一段内先后被改写为“该系统/该平台/该架构/该底座”）

en: Never flag grounded technical or domain identifiers when tied to concrete files, configs, protocols, or numeric bounds
Allow single isolated words; flag only paragraph-level clusters or unsupported marketing adjectives
zh: 严格区分 AI 空洞黑话与真实工程/业务行业黑话（如 Redis 兜底、WAL 落盘、PR 收口、告警打通均属扎实表达，不得误报）
单词孤立出现且上下文有事实锚点时不误报，仅在段落共现成簇或无事实支撑时标记

llmCheckPrompt.en: Check for AI buzzword clusters, nominalization bloat, and forced synonym cycling while leaving grounded domain terminology untouched.
llmCheckPrompt.zh: 识别空洞 AI 黑话簇、虚化动宾搭配与同义词强行轮换；严禁误伤带真实技术/业务锚点的行业术语。

name.en: Syntactic Frames, Inflated Copulas & Participle Tails
name.zh: 句法层：模板句壳、虚假施事与分词附庸尾句

en: Formulaic contrast pivots ('Not just X, but Y', 'It isn't about A; it's about B')
Dangling -ing commentary tails tacked onto factual clauses (', highlighting its pivotal role', ', underscoring the importance', ', ensuring seamless integration')
Inflated copulas & false-agency verbs ('serves as a testament to', 'stands as a beacon', 'boasts an array of', 'the data tells us')
Three-part balanced semicolon pitches, staccato slogan runs, and staged self-Q&A ('Why does this matter? Because...')
zh: 反转金句套壳（“不是 A，而是 B”“与其说……不如说……”高密度套用）
角色隐喻与伪载体句式（“扮演着重要角色”“作为……的重要载体/基石/桥梁”）
抽象跨度伪排比（“从……到……再到……”连接无实体落点的概念）、四字成语排比串与自问自答过渡（“这意味着什么？意味着……”）

en: Distinguish literal architectural roles ('proxy serves as TLS terminator') from puffed-up claims ('serves as a pivotal paradigm')
Allow genuine parallel debugging steps or crisp specifications
zh: 区分真实机制对比与空洞反转金句（如真实规格说明“A 不走 TCP，而是走 Unix socket”不应误报）
代码或表格中的并列技术参数列表不按排比口癖处罚

llmCheckPrompt.en: Spot formulaic syntactic shells (negation pivots, dangling -ing significance tails, inflated copulas, 3-part symmetry) that persist even after synonyms are swapped.
llmCheckPrompt.zh: 检查换词后仍在的句法骨架（“不是A而是B”反转、角色隐喻载体句、伪跨度排比与自问自答套壳），区分真实机制对比与空洞修辞。

name.zh: 节奏层：句长节拍器、长逗号链与助手排版噪点

en: Metronome sentence-length uniformity (low CV across 5+ sentences) and equal paragraph word budgets
Flat 5+ comma run-on chains and mechanical repetitive sentence openers
Inline **bold** lead-in bullet walls, confetti bolding inside prose, and excessive em-dashes
zh: 连续 5 句以上长度高度均一的节拍器节奏，或连续段落字数几乎均等切割
单句连续 5 个以上逗号平铺、机械同构句首开头
无节制加粗标签列表墙（`**关键词**：说明` 连续刷屏）、段内加粗噪点与过密破折号

en: Concise checklists, changelogs, API reference tables, and code blocks naturally share uniform line lengths and must not be penalized
Allow short, punchy cadence when deliberate in dialogue, release notes, or rules
zh: 规则清单、接口参数表、变更日志天然具有短句和规则排布，不得硬性要求改写打乱结构
中文技术列表与规范条目允许稳定格式，不与散文节奏混为一谈

llmCheckPrompt.en: Verify whether statistical flatness reflects true assistant smoothing rather than an intentional reference list or changelog.
llmCheckPrompt.zh: 结合文体判断平直节奏是否真是 AI 平滑铺陈；若原文是严谨操作规程或参数清单，勿为制造起伏而破坏清晰度。

name.en: Cognitive Framing: False Neutrality, Elevation & Fake Specificity
name.zh: 思维与表达层：虚假端水、强行宏大升华与无依据精确

en: False-neutral 'both-sides' hedging ('on the one hand ... on the other hand ... ultimately depends on your needs') refusing to make a concrete engineering/editorial call
Forced macro elevation & significance inflation ('marks a pivotal turning point', 'lays a solid foundation for future innovation')
Pre-emptive defensive disclaimers ('it is worth noting that no single approach solves everything')
Fake specificity / ghost attribution ('industry experts widely agree', 'studies show dramatic improvements')
zh: 虚假客观“端水”思维（“有利有弊，仁者见仁智者见智”“既要效率又要稳定，具体取决于业务场景”——回避直接下判断）
强行拔高意义与宏大叙事（“标志着……迈入新阶段”“为后续演进奠定了坚实基础”“彰显了深远价值”）
防御性免责铺垫（“需要客观说明的是，任何方案都非完美，但只要……”）
无来源伪具体背书（“业内专家普遍认为”“多项实测指标显示显著提升”）

en: Preserve legitimate trade-off analysis backed by concrete conditions, numbers, or threshold boundaries ('Use SQLite under 50k writes/day; move to Postgres beyond that')
Never strip real uncertainty qualifiers ('estimated', 'unless', 'pending verification')
zh: 区分“虚假端水”与“有边界条件的真权衡”（如明确写出“日写入低于 5 万用 SQLite，超过再切 Postgres”是精准判断，必须保留）
严禁把合理的风险限定词（“预计/仅在/除非/待实测确认”）当成防御性废话删掉

llmCheckPrompt.en: Inspect the reasoning frame: flag false-neutral hedging that dodges a clear judgment, ungrounded macro significance inflation, defensive padding, and fake-specificity attributions. Keep bounded trade-offs and real caveats intact.
llmCheckPrompt.zh: 重点审查思维与立意角度：抓出回避明确判断的“端水套话”、无支撑的宏大升华、冗余免责铺垫与伪权威归因；保留带真实边界条件与实测范围的严谨权衡。

name.en: Rhetorical Stance: Lecturing, Over-Explaining & Fake-Human Overcorrection
name.zh: 表达角度层：居高临下说教、冗余复述与廉价“装人味”

en: Didactic lecturing & faux profundity ('Let that sink in.', 'The real truth nobody talks about:', 'At its core, quality isn't a tool—it's a mindset')
Over-explaining & spoon-feeding (announcing what a clear datum obviously means right after stating it, plus redundant 'Key Takeaways' on short notes)
Sycophancy & chatbot residue leaks ('Great question!', 'I'd be happy to help')
Fake-human overcorrection: inserting forced slang, exclamation confetti, or fake typos just to sound casual
zh: 说教口吻与伪金句收尾（“本质上来说……”“说白了就是……”“真正的……从来不是……而是……”）
保姆式重复解释与强行总结（刚给出清楚的表格或数字，紧接着再用三句话“换言之，这充分说明了……”；短文硬塞“核心总结 / 下一步展望”）
助手客套残留与媚俗“装人味”过度纠偏（生硬插入“哈哈/家人们/绝绝子/其实吧/讲真”，破坏专业语体与原声风格）

en: Respect the author's real voice, sharp opinions, humor, and personal register when consistent with their voice card or literary/editorial genre
Never rewrite vivid human metaphors or crisp stance into bland bureaucratic prose
zh: 尊重并保留作者本来就有的锋芒观点、个人幽默、口语节奏或文风卡习惯，不得一刀切磨平成白开水
严禁通过塞入“说白了/其实吧”或磨平个性来伪造“人味”

llmCheckPrompt.en: Check writer-reader stance: flag didactic lecturing, spoon-feeding summaries after concrete facts, chatbot leaks, and cheesy fake-human slang. Protect genuine author personality, crisp humor, and direct judgment.
llmCheckPrompt.zh: 审查叙事姿态与视角：抓出居高临下的说教金句、事实后的保姆式复述、残留客套与廉价“装人味”口水词；同时保护作者原本鲜明的态度、个人视角与真实语气。

en: Preserve original author perspective, voice tension, and rhetorical personality; never flatten lively prose into sterile report boilerplate.
Preserve burstiness and natural short-long sentence rhythm contrast.
Preserve grounded industry/technical terms and concrete information density; delete padding, never delete substance.
Preserve modality bounds and uncertainty qualifiers (e.g., 'estimated', 'about', 'only if', 'pending benchmark').
Reject secondary AI slop and fake-human overcorrection slogans during edits.
zh: 保留原作者的人称视角、鲜明态度与表达魅力，绝不把有个性的文章改笨、改呆或磨平为千篇一律的干瘪公文。
保留长短句自然起伏，防止为了消解排比或长句而把全文切成均一短句。
保留带事实锚点的行业/技术专名与真实信息密度；只删水词废话，不删实质机制与判断依据。
严格保留数值、专名与范围/不确定限定词（预计、约、仅在、除非、待确认），绝不夸大成绝对承诺或幻觉编造数字。
禁止在改写或审校建议中引入新的 AI 套词（全闭环、赋能、抓手、“不是A而是B”）或廉价装人味填充词。
